**[P1] Release displaced records outside all plugin locks**

This calls `schedule()` while holding this invocation's `_lock`, and `schedule()` decrefs a displaced record before returning. If two concurrent invocations each displace a record whose customer-defined finalizer re-enters the other plugin, each thread holds its own lock while waiting for the other's, permanently hanging both invocations. The `RLock` only protects same-instance re-entry. Preserve the revision/queue handoff, but defer displaced and dropped record releases until the outer hook has exited every plugin lock; add a barrier-based two-instance regression test.
